title: WCTV Umbrella Giveaway
prize: Participate in the WCTV Umbrella Giveaway for a chance to win a WCTV-Tallahassee Roofing branded umbrella, valued at $25! WCTV will randomly select two winners each week and announce them on WCTV Eyewitness News at 5P every Tuesday. How To Enter: During the giveaway period, visit https://www.wctv.t
eligibilityText: Eligibility: Open only to legal residents of the United States who physically reside in the designated North Florida and South Georgia viewing area, and who are 18 years of age or older at the time of entry.
